# orca decision

Every `orca decision` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca decision list <group>`

a group's landed, pending and unlanded decisions

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca decision approve <group> <id> --undo-how <undo-how>`

approve a decision a landing refused, with an executable undo.how

- What it does: sends control verb `approve-pending-decision`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `<id>`: the pending item's id
- `--undo-how <undo-how>` (required): the executable undo

## `orca decision reject <group> <id> [--because <because>]`

reject a decision a landing refused (records a correction)

- What it does: sends control verb `reject-pending-decision`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `<id>`: the pending item's id
- `--because <because>`: a line of your own

## `orca decision ratify <group> <id>`

accept a landed decision Orca flagged

- What it does: sends control verb `ratify-flagged-decision`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `<id>`: the decision id

## `orca decision validate <path>...`

validate ledger file(s) or a directory (its top-level *.jsonl only)

- What it does: runs locally.
- Who may: anyone; runs here, needs no panel.
- `<path>` (one or more): a ledger file or directory
- Exit codes: 0 every line valid; 1 a line rejected, or nothing found to validate; 2 downgraded (nothing rejected).

```
orca decision validate .decisions
```

## `orca decision metrics [--root <root>] [--repo <repo>] [--as-of <as-of>]`

read-only: the correction rate, the repair rate and the backlog (--json: the report as JSON)

- What it does: runs locally.
- Who may: anyone; runs here, needs no panel.
- `--root <root>`: a directory whose git repositories are read
- `--repo <repo>` (repeatable): <projectKey>=<path>, repeatable
- `--as-of <as-of>`: an ISO 8601 instant: read what existed then
- Exit codes: 0 reported; 1 refused by name; 6 reported in full, and some lines were malformed.

```
orca decision metrics --root ~/code
orca decision metrics --repo orca=. --json
```

## `orca decision compact-reviews [--apply] [--root <root>] [--repo <repo>]`

compact the reviews store: a dry-run report, or --apply

- What it does: runs locally.
- Who may: anyone; runs here, needs no panel.
- `--apply`: write the compaction
- `--root <root>`: a directory whose git repositories are read
- `--repo <repo>` (repeatable): <projectKey>=<path>, repeatable
- Exit codes: 0 reported (and applied); 1 refused by name.

```
orca decision compact-reviews --repo orca=.
orca decision compact-reviews --apply --repo orca=.
```
